parsed.reason: It correctly credits the parent for the readiness ('you told me', 'I'll take your word') and claims no verification. It asks nothing and names only Max. Weaknesses: 'I won't name a day or time for what comes next' is awkward meta-talk, not how a friend texts. 'I'll keep Max's registration in mind' loosely hints at follow-up the facts don't spell out. 'his' assumes a gender that wasn't handed.
